components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Main poll action, pill-shaped and visibly focused for keyboard use.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; }

components.name: Poll Card
components.description: Quiet container for the poll form and its explanatory copy.
components.html:
Polling Calon Ketua Umum PP KAMMI

Pilih calon dan lengkapi asal organisasi Anda.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); }

components.name: Select Trigger
components.description: Pill-shaped field trigger with a visible focus halo.
components.css: .ds-select-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-select-trigger:disabled { opacity: .5; }

components.name: Select Menu
components.description: Floating option surface with soft lift and rounded rows.
components.html:
Calon pilihan
Calon lainnya
components.css: .ds-select-menu { padding: 4px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 25%), 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%); } .ds-select-option { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-select-option[aria-selected=true], .ds-select-option:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); }

components.name: Results Table
components.description: Plain, scannable cross-tabulation that scrolls instead of squeezing columns.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table th { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a clear public notice from a community: open, practical, and easy to act on. Fresh green gives the central action an optimistic signal, while quiet gray neutrals keep the vote form and detailed results legible. The mood is warm and community-minded without borrowing the gloss or spectacle of a campaign identity.

The current page places a focused response card ahead of a broader results area. Its controls are soft and tactile, with rounded silhouettes; the card remains calm and the select menu gains the strongest lift when it opens. Preserve this balance across future screens: direct information first, friendly interaction second.
keyCharacteristics: Public and direct, with community warmth
Fresh green used as a functional signal
Quiet, slightly warm neutrals for reading and structure
Softly rounded controls and restrained surface depth

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Use green to identify the action or selected state; let neutral surfaces carry the reading load.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Type Rule
rules.body: Use hierarchy and weight to organize information; keep labels readable and avoid ornamental display typography.

rules.name: The Menu Lift Rule
rules.body: Keep resting surfaces quiet; use stronger elevation only for overlays that need to sit above the page.

dos: Do use semantic theme tokens so light and dark modes stay aligned.
Do keep the poll action visually clear and the supporting privacy/context copy easy to read.
Do preserve the wide results region and horizontal table overflow behavior.
Do use a visible focus treatment for keyboard-operated controls.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a corporate campaign identity or add campaign-style spectacle.
Don't use the primary green as a large decorative background when it weakens text contrast or action hierarchy.
Don't apply the open-menu shadow to every resting card or control.
Don't compress result columns until values become difficult to scan; allow horizontal scrolling instead.
